_readme: FACTIONS [the sight numbers] 10/18 (rule 102d, Paolo 10/10: parties only inside your visible radius, how Battle Brothers does it; rule 88: a page, no sheet; rule 6 RESEARCH: test material in a bank, never in the game). draft:true. NOTHING IN THE GAME READS THIS FILE. The page is records/BOHEMIA_FACTIONS_HOW_FAR_A_COMPANY_SEES_ON_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MAP_10_18_26.md. TUNING puts these rows in the one table; RUN [sight radius] draws from the table, never from here.
base_is_a_fraction_because: WORLD [the region] and RUN may change the grid; a fraction of the map's width survives that and the blocks fall out of it (496 blocks today).

rows.why: half the glass at the far stop (202 blocks across); about nine hours' walk on open ground (135 blocks a day)
